notes.title: OUT NOW! Misc. A Tiny Tale is available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi again everyone!
I'm excited to say...  *[i][b]Drum roll[/b]*[/i][/p][h1]🎉 [u][b]Misc. A Tiny Tale is OUT NOW[/b][/u] 🎉[/h1][p][/p][p]And to celebrate, it'll be [i][b]15% off[/b][/i] for the first two weeks! 🤗[/p][p][/p][p]This game started as anything, a small idea that grew over time. Misc began in early 2020 right as covid hit, and through many years I worked on the game in my spare time between my day job. About halfway through development I was honored to be able to make the game my full time commitment and leave my job to work on the game, thanks to two government grants we received from Screenwest and Screen Australia. Their support has been nothing short of incredible and I’m so thankful for all their help.[/p][previewyoutube="Cbu_lmFn6E0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s come together with the talent of many hands, from programmers, artists, singers, voice actors, and more. I’m so thankful for each and every one of them for their help and touch on the game. I could talk about this game and the wonderful people that helped make it possible all day, but I’ll leave it at this...  It’s been an absolute honor and pleasure bringing this little world to life. It’s changed my life and I hope in some small way - the story and world we’ve put together here helps change others lives too. If I can do anything with this game, it’s to help the world see - no matter how different (or Miscellaneous) you feel in this world, you deserve to be here.


[b]The best way you can support us is to leave a REVEW! So please, once you've played the game a bit - don't forget to drop a review and share your thoughts.


[/b]I'm so incredibly eager to get the game into your hands, so thank you for sticking with me!
[url="https://discord.gg/Zw3UqMrB4b"]🔔 If you haven't already, join our community on Discord[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/miscatinytale.bsky.social"]🌈 And hop into the fun over at Bluesky! [/url]  [/p]

notes.title: Updated Release Plan: Steam on July 31, Switch on July 22
notes.notes:
[p]Heya everyone,[/p][p]We wanted to share a small update. [b]The Steam version of Misc. A Tiny Tale will now be launching just a tiny bit later, on [u]July 31st[/u].
[/b][/p][p]However, we’re still on track for our original launch for Nintendo Switch on July 22nd, so if you’re eager to jump in early, that platform version will be ready to go first![/p][p][/p][p]Misc was originally built around the Nintendo Switch hardware, and we’re so proud of how it runs on that platform. With this short delay, we’re taking a bit of extra time to make sure the PC version feels just as polished and comfortable to play, with high-end performance, better options for PC, and quality-of-life tweaks suited to mouse and keyboard. We’re also using the time to address feedback from early reviewers and fix up some final bugs, so launch day on Steam can be the best experience possible. On top of that, the Steam version [b]will now include a big set of achievements[/b] exclusive to this version. We’re working hard to make sure they feel fun and worth the effort for completionists to find![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support. It truly means the world. As a small thank you to our PC players, we’ll be launching Misc. A Tiny Tale on Steam with a [i][b]15% discount[/b][/i] to celebrate and welcome you into our tiny world![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/89570d6719c08a8482dcb8a30045d5344452352d.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re a small team, so a few extra days to polish and get everything sorted [i]will go a very long way[/i], and we’re incredibly thankful for your understanding and support. The game is so close now so please look forward to its release! Thank you for being on this journey with us. We’ll see you then![/p]

notes.title: NEW Trailer and release window! 🎊 Misc. A Tiny Tale
notes.notes:
[h1]A Heartwarming 3D Platformer Coming to PC and Nintendo Switch in 2025[/h1]

Today we're proud to share an all-new trailer for Misc. A Tiny Tale. Our last trailer was way back in 2022, so of course the game's come a long way. Misc is a charming 3D platformer that invites players to embark on a heartwarming journey with two tiny robots, Buddy and Bag Boy. Crafted from everyday objects, these lovable characters work together to make the world a better place—one tiny step at a time.

[previewyoutube=SlRa1fpf_d4;full][/previewyoutube]

We're excited to confirm the game will be releasing in [b]2025[/b]. It's been a long time coming, and getting to the point where a majority of the game is done has been nothing short of a journey. As we wrap things up and prepare for launch, seeing the story unfold and playing through all the games content has been a joy. We couldn't have done it without your support, so please look forward to more soon.

notes.title: Misc. A Tiny Tale - A wholesome new demo 🎉
notes.notes:
[h1]One last demo! Come see what's new.[/h1]

Since starting development way back in 2020, it's been an incredible journey working on Misc and seeing it grow over time. This year our focus has been completing the game by the end of the year, with a release aiming for sometime early 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/918451232c36e0e19b482d73c209545b399c6044.png[/img]
We were lucky enough to be part of Wholesome Games Steam Celebration, which highlights incredible wholesome games. As part of this celebration, we wanted to release an updated demo of Misc which brings the first two chapters of the game to it's current stage in development.

This updated demo has some new features and improvements.

- You can now get around faster by sprinting. Careful, don't use up all your battery!
- Better support for controller, letting you access every screen and menu with just a gamepad.
- Totally re-worked Gus challenges, if you played them the first time around it's well worth a revisit!
- Refined cinematics, which now feature subtitles and a skip button.
- More options for the player in the settings menu, including audio and visual options.
- You can now freely move around while cleaning with your brush for more control.
- Many bug fixes, dialogue changes, audio improvements and visual upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/fa0b1ee2f257ef0c589cde9e8ab38835366abd6a.png[/img]

notes.title: DEVLOG 8 🎁 - A New Demo!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's time for an update!✨[/h1]

We've been working on the game for over three years now. Last year we focused on the final three chapters of the game, so we could make sure the ending had enough love and care put into it. This year our focus is on completing the game by the end of the year, with a release aiming for sometime early 2025. In today's devlog we take a look at how the game has progressed, as well as celebrate through an all-new demo release.

This updated demo lets you explore the first two chapters of the game with some new features and improvements.

- An all-new cleaning system, letting you collect small, medium, and large trash pieces around the area.
- Recycle your trash at the RECYC0TRON machine near every shop. This will help you get some extra cash!
- Quests have now been added which let you keep track of your objectives, stamping them off with a unique design for each.
- As well as quests, you can see your overall progress with the help of the notes menu which features collected cogs, current items on hand, and more.
- You can now zoom in and out at any time using three different zoom levels.
- Many overall improvements to gameplay, controls, dialogue, visuals, and bug fixes.

notes.title: DEVLOG 3 🥳 - HUGE NEWS and release date!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's been a wild journey🌱[/h1]

It is with huge honor that we finally get to announce we're a recipient of Screen Australia's 'Games: Expansion Pack' grant! 🎉 This $150,00 grant will let us do many incredible things with the game. For our lead developer, it means he can focus full-time on the games development.

notes.title: We've fixed the camera control 📷
notes.notes:
[h2]We hear you and have fixed the camera! 🎉[/h2] 
Recently, a bunch of players discovered an issue with the camera where it was rotating too quickly when playing. This is actually a bug, where the camera's rotation rate was tied to the performance/framerate of the game, rather than being set by a constant value. [b]We've now fixed this, and more in our recent patch.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/d3efcbc79a290501d12a1687d79c7194ab7b13b9.png[/img]

We hope this bug fix encourages people who encountered the bug to [b]revisit the demo and give it another try. [/b]Check out the full list of patch notes below. 👇

[i]Demo Update Patch Notes:[/i]
[list]
[*] The camera has been fixed and now rotates at a set rate.
[*] The loading animation has been fixed and now runs at a set rate.
[*] In Chapter 2, the player can now be hit by an enemy, resulting in coins being removed.
[*] Small dialogue changes and improvements.
[/list]

To download the latest patch, simply launch the game. Steam should automatically download the latest patch.

notes.title: We won an award! 🏆 Colors Of Indie 2022 🌈
notes.notes:
[h3]Our team recently entered the first ever "Colors Of Indie" event hosted by Mooneye Studios.[/h3]

Colors Of Indie celebrates the many facets of indie games and tries to help the developers of those games with visibility, feedback, and some development funding. To enter, [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tinywaregames/video/7100045436462828802]we submitted a 'pitch' of our game on Tiktok.[/url] Our submission made it into the final nominees, alongside many other incredible indies.

The final results were recently announced, and our team is honored to have won 3rd place. 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/97d33f90fd4067eb346365b9d0d36c733ab42d6e.png[/img]

[i]"Misc. A Tiny Tale brings back a beloved genre of the past and works together with its dedicated community to bring you a fun story of friendship on an exciting journey."[/i]

[h2]What does this mean for Misc? [/h2]

As a winner of third place, our team will be receiving $200 which will directly go into the game's development. We're touched and so thankful people believe in our game. 🙏🏻😭  We highly recommend checking out the other incredible nominees and winners [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mooneye/sale/colorsofindie2022]which are currently visible on the Colors Of Indie steam page![/url] It was an absolute pleasure speaking to the Mooneye Studio team and pitching our game. They put together a special award ceremony which you can check out below. 

[previewyoutube=4hVoRIParUU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[i]"The small team at Tinyware Games comes from all around the world, from the U.S to Australia. They are a great demonstration of what the modern working world can look like. We've all had our experiences with remote work after the last couple of years and they have perfected it, since they have been developing their game for two years and never even met in person!"[/i]



This whole experience was really special to our team, so thank you once again Mooneye Studios for putting this together for the indie community. 😍

notes.title: Misc. A Tiny Tale - DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
As part of the [b]#SteamNextFest[/b], we've released an all-new demo that features the game's first two chapters. Previously, you could only play an early version of chapter 1. We've also put together a new trailer covering some things we've been working on outside the demo.

[previewyoutube=8_yVRukOfoc;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Demo Update Patch Notes:[/i] 
[list]
[*] [b]Chapter 2 has been added and is now playable[/b]
[*] The UI has had an overhaul, with cogs collected now being displayed in a meter.
[*] Controls are now displayed on-screen as you play.
[*] A loading screen/animation has been added.
[*] Character physics and overall control has been adjusted.
[*] Visuals overall have been improved for performance.
[*] Fixed a major bug on low-end computers which should increase performance.
[*] All cutscenes now run at 60fps with revamped visuals.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/50bd76fc409448f6a9d8cfdb48fcf4fbe2cced27.png[/img]

In chapter 2, you'll find yourself in the vibrant 'Chirping Woods'. Clean gunk around the level with your new brush tool, help quirky robots around you and discover the mystery behind the robotic inventor Atom. 🤖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/350f64c0975b0f461263d1aebddcb3ec90c08d3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/08f38b887cfc95fe09bf4fefa622a208de7da12b.png[/img]
